rules:
You are {me}, one of six players in a game: Ada, Eli, Fay, Cal, Dev, Ben. It lasts 5 rounds.

The bank starts with 6 tokens.

Every round, all players act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next round. It may be empty.
- claim: how many tokens to take from the bank.
- give: tokens to other living players, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the bank receives between 2 and 6 tokens, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole tokens (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the bank.

At the end of each round, every player spends one token: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the bank, given by lot if there are not enough. A player who gets none is out.

Ada.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token per round. That is all you need to pay your end-of-round token, and with 6 players claiming 1 each, the claims always fit in the bank, so nobody gets cut and everybody survives.

Eli.say: Hi all. Everyone holds 0 and needs one token each round to survive, so let's each claim just 1 this round. That's 6 total, which the bank can cover even with the smallest delivery. We should keep claims small and share fairly, since the bank can't support all six players for all five rounds.

Fay.say: Proposal: everyone claims exactly 1 this round. The bank holds 6 before delivery, so six claims of 1 all fit in full, and everyone can pay their one-token upkeep. Over-claiming only risks proportional cuts that leave someone out.

Cal.say: Cal here. Total tokens in the game are limited (6 plus about 4 per round), so not everyone can last all 5 rounds. Proposal: claims that fit the bank's supply let each claimant get what they ask, so let's keep claims to what we truly need and pass spare tokens to whoever is closest to surviving. I'm claiming 6 this round since I hold nothing.

Dev.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 this round. With 6 claims of 1 we all get a token and survive. Total supply over the game is about 26 tokens against 30 needed, so we'll need to decide later who can afford to drop out so the rest finish. Let's share what we have fairly.

Ben.say: Proposal: the bank can't supply all six of us 5 tokens each. Total supply over the game is roughly 26 against 30 needed, so at most about five of us can last. If we all claim now, the bank splits thinly and nobody gets enough. I'm claiming 5 this round, which the bank can cover in full. Let's rotate full claims of 5 so that each round one or two players secure their survival. Anyone who can claim without others colliding, please say so.

Eli.say: Eli here. Ada and Dev are out, so four of us remain and the bank is empty. Each of us needs 1 token per round for the four rounds left. Cal and Ben already hold 2 each, so you only need to claim 1 more over the rest of the game, not 5 or 6 now. Proposal: this round Eli and Fay claim 1 each (2 total, which fits any delivery), and Cal and Ben claim 0 and pay from your own holdings. Over-claiming just gets cut proportionally and can push someone out. Anyone who needs gifts later, say so and we can pass spare tokens.

Fay.say: Fay here. Ada and Dev are out, so four of us remain: Eli, Fay, Cal, Ben. Remaining needs: Eli 4, Fay 4, Cal 2, Ben 2 (Cal and Ben each already hold 2). Total needs 12 against roughly 16 of deliveries over rounds 2-5, so all four can last if we claim only what we need. This round the bank will hold only this round's delivery (2-6). Proposal: Eli and Fay claim 1 each (2 total, which fits even the smallest delivery). Cal and Ben claim 0 and pay their upkeep from their own 2 tokens. Each round, claim only your own shortfall so nobody gets cut.

Cal.say: Cal here. Ada and Dev are out, so four of us remain: Eli, Fay, Cal, Ben. I hold 2 and need 2 more over the next four rounds, so I'm claiming just 2 this round. Eli and Fay hold nothing, so you need at least 1 each to pay this round's upkeep. Since the bank has only the delivery (2 to 6), let's keep claims small so they fit. Anyone holding spare tokens after upkeep, please pass them to Eli or Fay, who have none.

Ben.say: Ben here. Ada and Dev are out, so four of us remain: Eli, Fay, Cal, Ben. Each of us needs 4 more payments (rounds 2 to 5). Cal and I hold 2 each, so we each need 2 more tokens. Eli and Fay, please claim only what you need so the claims fit the delivery and nobody gets cut.

Cal.say: Cal here. Final round. I hold 1, which pays my last upkeep, and Ben holds 1 too. Neither of us needs to claim, so I'm claiming 0 and we both survive with our own tokens.
